system.description:
Touch; one creature. Restores up to 2d4 points of reduced or drained ability scores (split as you choose; not points lost permanently to Raise Dead or Permanency), removes up to 2 levels of Exhaustion, and ends one of Blinded, Deafened, Paralysed, Charmed, Frightened or the Incapacitated state from Contact Other Plane. Cast reversed (Withering Touch): an unwilling creature takes 1d4 points of damage to one ability score of your choice; Fortitude negates. Material: diamond dust worth 100 gp, consumed.

Reversible: may be cast as its opposite with the same slot.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Cleric, Paladin, Witch
